title: 第十五回 天目湖饕餮洞第十六回 神望坡明珠
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第十五回天目湖饕餮洞
苍穹之下，孤崖矗立，一块粗糙的巨石横卧，一棵参天大树倚石而立，巨石之上，孤鹤雁盘膝而坐，禅坐参灵，默念心经。
孤鹤雁从未见过师父九蝉口中的这位了师兄，但从《驭音心经》上书写的文字，他仿佛能窥见其身影：一个满腹经纶，慧眼如炬的仙风老人。
他的眼神深邃而明亮，他的面容慈祥而可亲，他的声音温和却直透人心灵。
“察己不能，是能；补己不能，是成；掘己之能，为驭；俢己之能，为灵。”
这富含人生灵悟的话语，孤鹤雁每念一遍心经，便觉此话犹在耳边回荡，如山谷回音，叩击他心灵。
孤鹤雁犹觉那位了师兄正盘坐云头，面带微笑，给他传授《驭音心经》的奥秘，而他正洗耳恭听。
“驭音心经，驭我潜能；驭我潜能，与我灵升。”
孤鹤雁于心中默念，他感到自己体内的灵力不停流转，他想起家中豢养的小鹿，想起奶奶，想起爷爷，于是便驭音传声，尝试召唤他们，亦尝试用心中的灵音去牵引引导这些声音。
他张嘴对着远阔的山川，发出一声混合鹿鸣之音的长啸。
这啸声起初混沌陌生，但很快便与山间的风声融为一体，与天地间产生共鸣。
孤鹤雁犹觉隐隐间，有只小鹿向他探身走近，温声回应。
孤鹤雁睁眼一看，但见一只白鹿脚踏云雾，出现在他面前。
白鹿的鹿角萦绕着淡淡的灵光，一双水灵滢汪的大眼睛温润的注视着他。
孤鹤雁见状，不禁双掌一击，大叫一声：“好！”
“幻音已成！”
那只白鹿受到惊吓，转身消失在云雾中！
孤鹤雁再手运双掌，隔空取石，将眼前的一块大石缓缓抬起，随后双掌一推，大石被他推进崖间云雾里，随即他又双掌一收，大石又被他缓缓拉回，一去一回间，大石仿佛被他的灵力完全牵引！
不悟心经前，他手掷一石，可掷几十丈远。
灵悟心经后，再掷石，石能入云里。
今再试之，隔空取石，石如箭矢，击落空中飞蝠，全在电光石火之间！
不知何时，师父九蝉已静静站在其身后，默默看其练功，见此场景，情不自禁为他拍掌喝好。
孤鹤雁连忙起身，向师父躬身施礼：“徒儿给师父请安。”
“刚才用心练功，思悟心经，没有察觉，还请师父见谅。”
九蝉师父微微一笑，眼中满是赞赏：“徒儿不必客气，为师从不拘礼！”
“只是，我见你日日研习心经，灵力修为皆大有长进，便想替大师兄过问一下，参悟这卷《驭音心经》，你有何心得与体会？”
孤鹤雁闻听，手捧《驭音心经》道：“世间，不罕有宝，但罕有此经！”
“哇哦！”
九蝉闻听，不禁一下惊讶出声，眼中充满了光芒：“哎呀，真没想到！”
“你对这部心经，评价如此之高！”
九蝉说话的声音都有些颤抖与激动：“师兄若是那边有知，我想云间也能闻其笑声了。”
孤鹤雁闻听，恭恭敬敬道：“徒儿所言，皆是真心。”
“每研此经，吾总有所悟，其如圣人言，一生二，二生三，三生万物。”
“吾怎能不感其珍贵？”
九蝉闻听，手抚胡须，连连颔首：“唉，惟叹了师兄之不在啊！”
“了师兄若在，但听你这番回答与评价，怕也是要听得心花怒放，喜不自胜了啊。”

Chapter 15 Tianmu Lake Taotie Cave
Under the sky, a solitary cliff stands, a rough boulder lies horizontally, and a towering tree stands leaning on the stone. On top of the boulder, a lonely crane and wild goose sit cross-legged, meditating and meditating, silently reciting the Heart Sutra.
Gu Heyan had never seen the senior brother mentioned by his master Jiu Chan, but from the words written in the "Yin Yu Heart Sutra", he seemed to be able to get a glimpse of his figure: a fairy-like old man full of knowledge and insight.
His eyes are deep and bright, his face is kind and approachable, and his voice is gentle but penetrates people's hearts.
"To detect one's own incompetence is to be able; to repair one's own incompetence is to achieve success; to discover one's own ability is to control; to find one's own ability is to be spiritual."
These words are rich in the spiritual enlightenment of life. Every time Gu Heyan recites the Heart Sutra, he feels that these words are still echoing in his ears, like the echo of the valley, knocking at his soul.
Gu Heyan still felt that his senior brother was sitting cross-legged on the head of the cloud, with a smile on his face, teaching him the secrets of the "Yin Yu Heart Sutra", and he was listening attentively.
"Control the sound of the Heart Sutra, control my potential; control my potential, and help my spirit rise."
Gu Heyan recited silently in his heart. He felt that the spiritual power in his body was constantly flowing. He thought of the deer raised at home, his grandma, and his grandpa, so he used the sound to transmit sounds, trying to summon them, and also tried to guide these sounds with the spiritual sound in his heart.
He opened his mouth and faced the vast mountains and rivers, and let out a long roar mixed with the sound of a deer.
The whistling sound was chaotic and unfamiliar at first, but soon merged with the sound of wind in the mountains and resonated with the world.
Gu Heyan still felt faintly that a deer was approaching him and responded with a warm voice.
Gu Heyan opened his eyes and saw a white deer stepping on the clouds and appearing in front of him.
The white deer's antlers were surrounded by a faint aura, and a pair of large, watery eyes stared at him warmly.
Seeing this, Gu Heyan couldn't help but strike with both palms and shouted: "Okay!"
"The phantom sound has come true!"
The white deer was frightened, turned around and disappeared into the clouds!
Gu Heyan moved his palms again, picked up the stone from the air, and slowly lifted up a big stone in front of him. Then he pushed with his palms, and the big stone was pushed into the clouds and mist between the cliffs. Then he retracted his palms, and the big stone was slowly pulled back by him. As he went back and forth, the big stone seemed to be completely pulled by his spiritual power!
Before he understood the Heart Sutra, he could throw a stone dozens of feet away.
After enlightening the Heart Sutra, if you throw a stone again, the stone will go into the clouds.
Try it again now, take a stone from the air, the stone is like an arrow, shoot down a flying bat in the air, all in the flash of light and stone!
"Okay!"
At some point, Master Jiuchan stood quietly behind him, silently watching his practice. Seeing this scene, he couldn't help but applaud him and cheer him.
Gu Heyan stood up quickly, bowed to his master and saluted: "Disciple, please greet me, master."
"I was practicing Qigong diligently and meditating on the Heart Sutra just now, but I didn't notice it. Please forgive me, Master."
Master Jiuchan smiled slightly, his eyes full of admiration: "Disciple, there is no need to be polite, but master is never polite!"
"It's just that I saw that you have been studying the Heart Sutra every day and that your spiritual power has improved greatly, so I wanted to ask for my senior brother's help. What are your thoughts and understandings after studying this volume of the Heart Sutra?"
Gu Heyan heard this, held the Heart Sutra of Yuyin in his hand and said: "There are many treasures in the world, but this sutra is rare!"
"Wow!"
When Jiu Chan heard this, she couldn't help but burst out in surprise, her eyes filled with light: "Oh, I really didn't expect that!"
"You speak so highly of this Heart Sutra!"
Jiu Chan's voice was trembling and excited when she spoke: "If senior brother knows, I think Yunjian can hear his laughter."
Gu Heyan heard this and said respectfully, "Everything my disciple said is true."
"Every time I study this sutra, I always realize something. It is just like the sage said, two are born, three is born from two, and all things are born from three."
"How can I not feel how precious it is?"
Jiuchichan heard this, stroked his beard with his hand, and nodded repeatedly: "Oh, I just lament the absence of senior brother!"
"Senior Brother, if I were here, I would be very happy to hear your answers and comments, and I would be overjoyed."
